problem: Native x86 full-suite execution exposed recursive control-flow reverse-postorder traversal exhausting the 1 MiB stack used by the long-expression-chain regression. An isolated rerun could pass; the bounded deep-graph negative control reliably reproduced stack exhaustion.
fix: Use an explicit DFS cursor stack, preserving successor/root ordering, cycle handling and unsettled-successor filtering. O(V+E) work and O(V) heap storage; no compiler limit or native stack-size change.
new_regressions: Ordering for roots, shared descendants, cycles, duplicate edges, and unsettled depths; exhaustive parity against the previous traversal over all 65536 directed four-node graphs.
100000-block chain with terminal self-loop on an explicitly 1 MiB thread stack.
